edge_types.documented-diffusion: one tradition demonstrably copied/inherited from another (traceable lineage)
edge_types.shared-vocabulary: same root-terms drawn from a common word-hoard (esp. Indic raga/dvesa/moha/avidya)
edge_types.false-friend: looks parallel, is a category error or translation accident

_meta.thesis_status: DEMOTED. Not 'independent discoveries of one object' but 'shared vocabulary + family resemblance + one real transmission (Stoa->CBT) usually misfiled as convergence'. See README §4.

hard_breaks: sloth/acedia: no clean cognate; Islam reverses valence; the vice CBT explains best is the one religions barely name
Jain maya (deceit): no slot in seven sins OR CBT — interpersonal-strategic, not appraisal-error
envy: absent from Sikh five & Jain four; a late Gregorian editorial insert
delusion/ignorance: Indic root with ZERO Christian slot; conversely the sins' juridical core has no Buddhist/Jain/CBT cognate
external tempter (Shaytan waswasa, Zoroastrian daevas): breaks the interiority both Augustine and Beck assume
drive-is-good-when-channeled (Vedic kama, yetzer hara 'very good'): sin-frame cannot represent it
CBT internal: distortions are many-to-many with vices; several popular distortions are research-baseless folklore; Egyptian 42 Confessions = denied DEEDS not inner states (category error)
